pr_body:
Implemented in three sequential Claude Code prompts.

- step 1: scaffolding
- step 2: tests
- step 3: docs

prompts.label: Scaffold module
prompts.prompt: Create a new module foo with an entrypoint and a stub function bar(). Commit when done.
acceptance: src/foo exists with an exported bar()
Working tree is clean after the commit

prompts.label: Add tests
prompts.prompt: Add unit tests for foo.bar covering the happy path and one edge case. Commit when done.
acceptance: Tests cover the happy path and one edge case

prompts.label: Document module
prompts.prompt: Add a short README section describing foo and example usage. Commit when done.
acceptance: README has a foo section with a usage example
